item.title: Tonverk: Subtractive Synthesis Explained
item.description: video upload by EZBOT "The Tonverk isn't just a sampler or multi-sampler, it's a synthesizer that can play single cycle waveforms polyphonically. This coupled with wavefolding, distortion, rectification, and modulators.. you have a very powerful synthesizer. Let me explain.." EZBOT resources: https://www.patreon.com/ezbot, https://ko-fi.com/ezbot/, https://www.modbang.com"

item.title: Frequency Guillotine, a randomizable 16 band filterbank plugin. Prophet 12 #audioplugin #filterbank
item.description: video upload by copenhagennoiselab "A short demo of an upcoming filterbank for mac and pc (au and vst3). A simple patch from the prophet12 is being processed by the filterbank. Utilizing random, synced random, random slew, etc for creating movement of band levels as well as panning. Coming soon from Unusable.Ai studios."
